commentary.name: Inditex
commentary.inventory_comment: Inventory EUR 3,789m, +9.3% yoy vs 1H sales +7.6% (+9.2% cc); company calls it "high quality"; call script: inventory up "in line with the sales evolution". Cash-flow change in inventories EUR -549m vs -119m a year earlier. Gap vs sales widened from 1Q (+1%).
commentary.demand_comment: Store and online sales +9% cc for 1 Aug-7 Sep 2026; Q2 sales ~+9.1% reported.
commentary.cost_comment: Q2 gross margin 56.7% (1H 58.7%); press coverage (Textalks) quotes higher transport and input costs from Middle East conflict disruption. Not verified in the primary PDF (inditex.com fetch blocked).

commentary.name: Inditex
commentary.inventory_comment: Inventory EUR 3,812m, ~1% higher yoy; "high quality".
commentary.demand_comment: Sales +5.8% reported, +8.8% constant currency.
commentary.cost_comment: Gross margin 61.2% (record per press).

commentary.name: H&M
commentary.inventory_comment: Stock-in-trade SEK 39,355m, +4% SEK / +9% currency-adjusted; attributed to "increased value of goods in transit" from "disruption in global supply chains" plus EU logistics consolidation; composition "good"; 17.8% of rolling sales (16.4%).
commentary.demand_comment: Q3 sales +1% local currency with ~2% fewer stores; Sept 2026 expected +1% local currency.
commentary.cost_comment: External factors had a "slightly negative effect on purchasing costs", mainly freight; ~1.6pp one-off margin gain from tariffs/goods imports; Q4 external factors "somewhat negative", markdowns to rise somewhat. No cotton mention.

commentary.name: H&M
commentary.inventory_comment: Stock-in-trade -10% SEK / -2% currency-adjusted; CEO: tighter inventory management "in some cases affected our ability to fully meet demand".
commentary.demand_comment: Q2 sales -1% local currency; June expected flat.
commentary.cost_comment: External factors somewhat positive on purchasing costs; Q3 external factors expected neutral; monitoring Middle East; low share of air freight; started process on US tariff compliance.

commentary.name: Fast Retailing (Uniqlo)
commentary.inventory_comment: Inventories JPY 617.2bn vs 511.0bn (+20.8%) vs revenue +16.6%; no segment comment in tanshin. Earlier in year inventory growth (+6% to +11%) was below revenue growth and described as "within the appropriate range".
commentary.demand_comment: Revenue +16.6%; UNIQLO International +26.2%, Japan +5.7% (SSS +5.1%). FY2027 guide revenue +12.3%.
commentary.cost_comment: UNIQLO Japan GM -0.1pt; weaker yen forward rates raised procurement cost in H1/2H; H1 presentation flagged higher transport costs in some markets and energy-supply restrictions in parts of SE Asia (Middle East); no cotton/raw material mention.

commentary.name: Fast Retailing (Uniqlo)
commentary.inventory_comment: Inventory JPY 497.7bn, +48.7bn yoy (mainly UNIQLO International) per presentation; GU narrowed product count to optimise inventory.
commentary.demand_comment: 9M revenue +17.1%; Q3 UNIQLO Intl +33.8%, Japan +10.0%.
commentary.cost_comment: Japan cost-of-sales ratio improved on stronger yen forward rates; discount rates slightly higher; GU cut materials/procurement costs.

commentary.name: Primark (ABF)
commentary.inventory_comment: Group inventories GBP 3,053m vs 3,169m; working capital inflow GBP 228m "mainly due to benefit from reduced inventory in Primark".
commentary.demand_comment: Primark sales +2% cc (new space +5%), LFL -2.6% (UK +0.5%, Continental Europe -4.7%); FY2027 space growth ~+4%; adj. margin ~10%.
commentary.cost_comment: Profit hit by LFL decline "and related markdowns"; FX a margin benefit; US tariffs cited only as a US consumer-sentiment factor; no cotton cost mention.

commentary.name: Primark (ABF)
commentary.inventory_comment: Reduction in Primark inventory since year end; "managed inventories effectively in a difficult trading environment".
commentary.demand_comment: LFL -2.7%; softening in April as Middle East conflict hit consumers; risk to sales if conflict persists.
commentary.cost_comment: Flags longer-term cost impacts "such as energy, freight and fabric"; 2026 impact "manageable"; well hedged on energy and FX.

commentary.name: Next plc
commentary.inventory_comment: Surplus stock higher than last year in UK Online, Retail and International ("Surplus stock increased by more than sales" online); better clearance in stores. Earlier: Sale stock +5% at Christmas 2025 and +5% into summer 2025 Sale.
commentary.demand_comment: Full-price sales +7.7%; Q2 +9.2% (5 Aug 2026 statement); FY guide full-price GBP 6.0bn (+6.7%).
commentary.cost_comment: Middle East parcel surcharges cut International margin 0.8pt; fuel +GBP 27m cost; GBP 2m US tariff refund; bought-in gross margin +0.5pt on NEXT brand. No cotton mention.

commentary.name: Shenzhou International
commentary.inventory_comment: Own inventory RMB 7,316.7m vs 6,709.9m at Dec 2025; "brands remain cautious about restocking overall".
commentary.demand_comment: Revenue -5.3%; customers "more cautious in placing orders", increased order volatility; sportswear -10.7%.
commentary.cost_comment: Industry review: "Cotton prices rose across the board"; synthetic fibre costs up with oil; US tariffs on China apparel "remain high"; GM -4.5pt to 22.6%.

commentary.name: Crystal International
commentary.inventory_comment: Inventory USD 414.9m vs 321.6m at Dec 2025.
commentary.demand_comment: "Strong order momentum from its brand customers"; H2 growth expected to outpace H1; capacity constraints, hiring 6,000; denim -8.6%.
commentary.cost_comment: Fabric costs "generally borne by brand customers" (pass-through); oil lifted synthetic fibre costs.

commentary.name: Gildan Activewear (incl. Hanesbrands)
commentary.inventory_comment: Own inventory USD 2,068m, -12.7% vs Dec 2025; customers held back replenishment to "manage working capital levels" (~USD 145m impact); lower seasonal builds at large retailers.
commentary.demand_comment: "Softer-than-anticipated demand by end consumers"; FY2026 revenue guide cut to USD 5.4-5.5bn from 6.0-6.2bn; 2026-2028 targets withdrawn.
commentary.cost_comment: "Lower raw material and manufacturing costs" supported GM; IEEPA refunds ~USD 177m in Q3; outlook assumes 10% Sec.122 (Feb-Jul 2026) then 10-12.5% Sec.301 on Asian imports.

commentary.name: Eclat Textile
commentary.inventory_comment: n/a
commentary.demand_comment: Oct revenue +10.7% yoy; YTD +5.9%; press (UDN, via search) says Q4 orders remain strong and full-year revenue may hit a record.
commentary.cost_comment: Mix shift to higher-margin customers (press). Third-party source; verify.

commentary.name: Makalot Industrial
commentary.inventory_comment: n/a
commentary.demand_comment: Oct revenue +15.1% yoy but YTD only +1.3%; broker (Aug 2026, via press) cut estimates citing order uncertainty and weak US customer demand.
commentary.cost_comment: n/a. Third-party source; verify.

commentary.name: Yue Yuen / Pou Chen
commentary.inventory_comment: n/a (footwear, little cotton relevance)
commentary.demand_comment: H1 revenue USD 3.97bn -2.2%; shoe shipments -6.4%, ASP +1.6%; manufacturing GM 14.3%.
commentary.cost_comment: Third-party summary; primary filing not opened.

commentary.name: Gap Inc
commentary.inventory_comment: Merchandise inventory USD 2,305m vs 2,459m (~-6%); no inventory outlook given.
commentary.demand_comment: Sales +2%, comps flat; demand softened Oct/early Nov on warm weather; FY sales now ~flat (was +1-1.5%); Q4 flat to -1%.
commentary.cost_comment: Merch margin +40bp ex-IEEPA on lower tariff rates, partly offset by higher fuel; YTD IEEPA recovery USD 420m in COGS; outlook ~10% incremental tariff from 24 Feb 2026 then high-teens. No cotton mention.

commentary.name: Gap Inc
commentary.inventory_comment: "Ending inventory of $2.3 billion was flat compared to last year" (2,297 vs 2,294).
commentary.demand_comment: Sales -2%, comps -1%.
commentary.cost_comment: USD 417m net IEEPA recovery (~512m refunds less ~95m shared with vendors); assumed ~10% incremental Sec.301 rate from 24 Jul 2026; freight/fuel only as risk factor.

commentary.name: Abercrombie & Fitch
commentary.inventory_comment: Inventories USD 763m vs 730m (+~4%) vs sales +11%; figures include IEEPA/Sec.122/Sec.301 tariffs.
commentary.demand_comment: Sales +11%, comps +6%; FY sales guide raised to ~+6%; Q4 ~+7%.
commentary.cost_comment: Q3 tariff expense ~USD 10m offset by ~20m IEEPA refunds; rest of year assumes 10-12.5% effective tariff (was 15%). No freight/cotton mention.

commentary.name: Abercrombie & Fitch
commentary.inventory_comment: Inventories USD 592m vs 593m (flat) vs sales +5%.
commentary.demand_comment: Sales +5%, comps flat.
commentary.cost_comment: ~USD 100m IEEPA refunds in COGS; Q2 tariff expense ~15m net of mitigation.

commentary.name: American Eagle Outfitters
commentary.inventory_comment: Inventory at cost +14%, units +9%; cost increase "includes the impact of incremental tariffs"; unit plans to be "rebalanced between brands and categories".
commentary.demand_comment: Revenue +8%, comps +6% (Aerie +19%, AE -1%); Q3 comps guide mid-to-high single digit.
commentary.cost_comment: USD 196m IEEPA refunds (net op. income benefit 161m); merch margin -330bp. No cotton/freight mention. Q3 not yet reported.

commentary.name: American Eagle Outfitters
commentary.inventory_comment: Inventory at cost +27% to USD 817m, units +5% (tariffs plus lapping prior-year write-down).
commentary.demand_comment: Revenue +10%, comps +8%.
commentary.cost_comment: Guide assumed 10% tariff on Q2 receipts and 15% for back half.

commentary.name: Levi Strauss
commentary.inventory_comment: "Total inventories decreased 3% on a dollar basis compared to Q3 2025"; units not given.
commentary.demand_comment: Revenue +4% reported, +5% organic; FY organic guide ~+6%.
commentary.cost_comment: IEEPA refunds USD 79m in COGS (+490bp GM, ~120bp redeployed); assumes current tariff rates hold. No cotton/product-cost comment.

commentary.name: Levi Strauss
commentary.inventory_comment: "Total inventories decreased 7% on a dollar basis compared to Q2 2025".
commentary.demand_comment: Revenue +8% reported, +6% organic.
commentary.cost_comment: Not captured.

commentary.name: PVH
commentary.inventory_comment: "Inventory: Decreased 3% to $1.738 billion compared to the prior year period."
commentary.demand_comment: Revenue -3%; Q3 guide down low single digits; FY revenue ~flat.
commentary.cost_comment: Lower product costs incl. FX; higher net tariff costs; USD 107m tariff refunds (+510bp GM); FY assumes 15% US tariff rate, ~USD 195m gross EBIT hit.

commentary.name: PVH
commentary.inventory_comment: "Inventory: Decreased 5% to $1.510 billion compared to the prior year."
commentary.demand_comment: Revenue +2% reported, -2% constant currency.
commentary.cost_comment: Tariff headwind offset by "lower product costs, including a positive impact of foreign exchange".

commentary.name: VF Corp
commentary.inventory_comment: "Net inventories up 7% vs. LY to support demand in H2'27" (planned purchases).
commentary.demand_comment: Revenue -4% (+1% ex-Dickies); Vans -10%, TNF +4%, Timberland +4%; FY guide reaffirmed (+2% or better cc).
commentary.cost_comment: GM +320bp to 55.4%; USD 55.9m IEEPA inventory reserve released so tariffs neutral to FY27 GM; raw material/tariff volatility only as risk factors. Q1 FY2027 not collected (search budget exhausted).
